en: The longest road in Unova is Route 13, I'm told. Take your time, or you'll still be on it by sunset.
text: Cel mai lung drum din Unova este Route 13, mi se spune. Nu te grăbi, altfel vei fi încă pe el la apus.

en: I clear my own path with Hidden Moves. Cut, Strength, Surf: they save so much walking!
text: Mi-am croit singur drumul cu Mișcări Ascunse. Cut, Strength, Surf: economisesc atât de mult mers!
